  SELECT c.CustomerId,
         c.Country,
         c.FirstName,
         c.LastName,
         SUM(i.Total) AS AmountSpent

results.question: For each genre, find the track that was bought the most. Show the genre, track name, and number of purchases.
results.gold_sql: WITH track_sales AS (SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name AS Genre, t.TrackId, t.Name AS Track, SUM(il.Quantity) AS purchases FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, t.TrackId), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY GenreId ORDER BY purchases DESC) AS rnk FROM track_sales) SELECT Genre, Track, purchases FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY Genre
results.sql:
WITH TrackPurchases AS (
    SELECT 
        g.GenreId,
        g.Name AS Genre,
        t.TrackId,
        t.Name AS TrackName,
        COALESCE(SUM(il.Quantity), 0) AS Purchases
    FROM Genre g
    JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name, t.TrackId, t.Name
)

    Genre,
    TrackName,
    Purchases
FROM (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY GenreId ORDER BY Purchases DESC) AS rnk
    FROM TrackPurchases
) ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY Genre

    SELECT 
        a.ArtistId,
        a.Name AS Artist,
        al.AlbumId,

        SUM(il.Quantity) AS TracksSold
    FROM Artist a
    JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId

results.question: For each country, show the customer who bought the highest number of different tracks.
results.gold_sql: WITH customer_tracks AS (SELECT c.Country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT il.TrackId) AS tracks FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY c.Country, c.CustomerId), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY tracks DESC) AS rnk FROM customer_tracks) SELECT Country, FirstName, LastName, tracks FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY Country
results.sql:
WITH CustomerTrackCounts AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId,
         c.FirstName,
         c.LastName,
         c.Country,
         COUNT(DISTINCT il.TrackId) AS DistinctTrackCount
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Country
),
CountryMax AS (
  SELECT Country, MAX(DistinctTrackCount) AS MaxTrackCount
  FROM CustomerTrackCounts
  GROUP BY Country
)
SELECT ctc.CustomerId,
       ctc.FirstName,
       ctc.LastName,
       ctc.Country,
       ctc.DistinctTrackCount AS TrackCount
FROM CustomerTrackCounts ctc
JOIN CountryMax cm
  ON cm.Country = ctc.Country
 AND cm.MaxTrackCount = ctc.DistinctTrackCount
ORDER BY ctc.Country
results.answer: The highest number of different tracks bought by any customer in each country is 38, and several customers tie for that top count in each nation (e.g., Diego Gutiérrez in Argentina, Mark Taylor in Australia, Astrid Gruber in Austria, Daan Peeters in Belgium, Luís Gonçalves, Eduardo Martins, Alexandre Rocha, Roberto Almeida and Fernanda Ramos in Brazil, etc.).

    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           c.FirstName,
           c.LastName,
           c.Country,

    FROM Customer c

results.question: For every playlist, find the artist that appears most often in that playlist.
results.gold_sql: WITH artist_playlist AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name AS Playlist, ar.ArtistId, ar.Name AS Artist, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, ar.ArtistId), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PlaylistId ORDER BY track_count DESC) AS rnk FROM artist_playlist) SELECT Playlist, Artist, track_count FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY Playlist
results.sql:
WITH ArtistCounts AS (
    SELECT pt.PlaylistId, al.ArtistId, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
    FROM PlaylistTrack pt
    JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    GROUP BY pt.PlaylistId, al.ArtistId
)
SELECT p.PlaylistId,
       p.Name AS PlaylistName,
       ar.ArtistId,
       ar.Name AS ArtistName,
       ac.TrackCount
FROM (
    SELECT ac.*,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PlaylistId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC) AS rnk
    FROM ArtistCounts ac
) ac
JOIN Playlist p ON ac.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
JOIN Artist ar ON ac.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE ac.rnk = 1
ORDER BY p.PlaylistId

    GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, al.AlbumId, al.Title
) AS ranked_albums
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY ArtistId
